`enum GlProfile`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.opengl.capability` · **Module:** `base-opengl` · **Source:** [GlProfile.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/opengl/capability/GlProfile.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span> <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

Whether an OpenGL context keeps the fixed pipeline (compatibility) or drops it (core, forward-compatible core).

## Learn more

- [Capabilities and paths](/build/base-modules/opengl/#capabilities-and-paths)

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`COMPATIBILITY`](#GlProfile-value-COMPATIBILITY) | A context that keeps the fixed pipeline: the state guard also turns off fog, lighting, alpha test and color material for JOID. |
| [`CORE`](#GlProfile-value-CORE) | A core profile, without the fixed pipeline. |
| [`CORE_FORWARD_COMPATIBLE`](#GlProfile-value-CORE_FORWARD_COMPATIBLE) | A forward-compatible core profile, the only kind of core context on macOS. |

## Value details

### COMPATIBILITY

`COMPATIBILITY` 

A context that keeps the fixed pipeline: the state guard also turns off fog, lighting, alpha test and color material for JOID.
